description: This file defines a React component 'HabitList' responsible for displaying a list of habits with features like search filtering, marking habits as completed for today, editing, and deleting habits. It also provides a button to create new habits, integrating UI components such as Button, Card, and Badge, as well as utility functions and context for state management.

methods.name: HabitList({ onSelect, onCreate, onEdit })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a list of habits with options to create, select, edit, mark as completed for today, or delete habits.
